transcript.speaker: Eve Smith
transcript.text: Hi Frank, thanks for joining. I wanted to walk you through our new enterprise tier.

transcript.speaker: Eve Smith
transcript.text: Are you currently looking to upgrade from your professional plan?

transcript.speaker: Frank White
transcript.text: Hi Eve. Yes, we are definitely interested in the enterprise tier.

transcript.speaker: Frank White
transcript.text: Our main concern right now is data residency. We need to ensure all our data stays within the EU.

transcript.speaker: Eve Smith
transcript.text: I completely understand. The good news is our new enterprise tier includes selectable regions.

transcript.speaker: Eve Smith
transcript.text: I can send you the documentation on our EU data centers. Will that help?

transcript.speaker: Frank White
transcript.text: That would be perfect. If the documentation looks good, we can move forward with a trial next month.

transcript.speaker: Eve Smith
transcript.text: Excellent. We'll also need to sign a new NDA before the trial starts. I'll have legal draft that up.

transcript.speaker: Frank White
transcript.text: What is the pricing for the enterprise tier for 500 seats?

transcript.speaker: Eve Smith
transcript.text: For 500 seats, we offer a volume discount. It comes down to $45 per seat per month.

transcript.speaker: Frank White
transcript.text: That sounds reasonable. So the total annual contract value would be around $270,000?

transcript.speaker: Eve Smith
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. And that includes a dedicated customer success manager.

transcript.speaker: Frank White
transcript.text: I will need to run this past our VP of Finance tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Eve Smith
transcript.text: Sure. I will send over the formal quote along with the EU docs today.

transcript.speaker: Frank White
transcript.text: Great. Please make sure the quote has the 10% volume discount explicitly stated.

transcript.speaker: Eve Smith
transcript.text: I will ensure that is highlighted. Any other questions?

transcript.speaker: Frank White
transcript.text: No, I think that covers it. Let's aim to sign the NDA by Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: Eve Smith
transcript.text: Sounds like a plan. Looking forward to reviewing the docs. Thanks Frank.

summary.overview_text: Sales discussion with Acme Corp regarding the enterprise tier. The client emphasized the need for EU data residency, which the enterprise tier supports. Eve will send documentation and draft an NDA to proceed with a trial next month.

Send formal quote with 10% volume discount
Run quote past VP of Finance tomorrow
